description.narrative: Investments of up to EUR 100 million in a series of senior preferred bonds ("SP Bonds") and senior non-preferred bonds ("SNP Bonds") to be issued by Luminor Bank AS in Estonia ("the Issuer") until March 2026 and admitted for trading on the Irish Stock Exchange. EBRD's investment in each issue will be limited to up to 20% of the issuance size. On 31 May 2023, EBRD invested EUR 50 million in the issuance of EUR 300 million senior preferred bonds by the Issuer. The bonds have a four-year maturity with a call option on the third year. On 3 September 2024, EBRD invested EUR 20 million in the issuance of EUR 300 million senior preferred bonds by the Issuer. The bonds have a four-year maturity with a call option on the third year. On 3 June 2025, EBRD invested EUR 12 million in the issuance of EUR 300 million senior preferred bonds by the Issuer. The bonds have a four-year maturity with a call option on the third year. The project supports the resilience of a systemic bank through achieving regulatory compliance and ensures its continued access to international capital markets. The Project aims to scale up Green Economy Transition ("GET") financing in the Baltic countries with the Issuer agreeing to allocate 150% of the EBRD's invested amount into GET-eligible projects.
